trigger: ordinary-use friction: FIELD landing required an unnecessary explicit OPEN after focus for safe local navigation
HUMAN PORT demonstrated that automatically mounting the existing Field Aperture against the current source is materially more usable than requiring a separate inspector workflow
DOCS / READ was still a plain <pre> despite the shared aperture already supporting TEXT and JSON
RSVP control was fixed at 300 WPM despite the underlying temporal-focus mechanism supporting much faster stepping

changes: focus event schema advanced to field-aperture-focus/v0.2
RSVP WPM control expanded to 60–3000 WPM with preset stepping and keyboard control
RSVP timer changed from fixed setInterval to reschedulable dwell so speed changes apply immediately and punctuation/long tokens may receive bounded extra dwell
position / scale / source magnitude now emit material state as CSS custom properties and aperture-material events
material-target attribute can project that state into a host element without changing source data
DOCS / READ embeds the same aperture automatically for every selected control document and materializes scale/position into the page field
standalone APERTURE workbench uses the same whole-space material projection
FIELD safe local navigation now uses focus-first / second-click-open on route/survivor/latest items; explicit OPEN remains available

authority: FIELD second-click navigation is limited to local repository routes and is not generalized to HUMAN PORT/external/consequential actions
RSVP speed range is an experimental control range, not a comprehension claim

static: APERTURE workbench inline JavaScript parse PASS
FIELD INDEX inline JavaScript parse PASS
external_benchmark: Current RSVP products commonly expose adjustable speed above ordinary reading rates; examples found during this pass include 1000+ WPM and one current extension advertising 50–2000 WPM. This motivated removing the 300 WPM UI ceiling but does not validate comprehension at high speed.

next_use: Use DOCS normally and observe whether material scale/position improves orientation or becomes visual noise.
Use RSVP at personally useful rates; if high-speed use exposes need for chunking/ORP/smart pauses, treat each as a separate mechanism test.
Observe whether FIELD second-click-open removes friction without causing accidental navigation.
return: One existing component now carries source identity, scale, position, time and material host state across HUMAN PORT, DOCS, FIELD dock and standalone APERTURE. No new sovereign project.
